description: Stops Umbraco's telemetry beacon, installer reporting and dashboard news requests on servers without internet access. Registers automatically in Umbraco 17 and 18 through dependency injection.

Dependency injection container for .NET with MEF-style attribute composition, keyed services, dynamic registration and a compile-time registration source generator. The Prism adapter ships as a separate project (Vane.Container.Prism).

ASP.NET Core host integration for Vane.Container. Adds UseVaneContainer on IHostBuilder through IServiceProviderFactory<ServiceRegistry> and serves per-request scopes from IServiceScopeFactory. Targets net10.0.
Prism 8 IContainerExtension adapter for Vane.Container. Routes PrismApplication container creation, RegisterSingleton/RegisterInstance/RegisterScoped and Resolve/ResolveAll calls into Vane.Container.
SqlChat public API: ISqlChatClient, SqlChatBuilder and dependency-injection registration.
Natural language to validated, read-only SQL for PostgreSQL and SQL Server, powered by Anthropic Claude or OpenAI. Start here: includes the full SqlChat stack.

SqlChat orchestration engine and read-only SQL security validation. Referenced by SqlChat.Client; install SqlChat.Ai instead.
SqlChat schema providers (PostgreSQL, SQL Server, EF Core, DDL/JSON/YAML) and read-only query executors.
